    { t: 1220, sq: 0.00, lean:  0.0, hr:   0, fr:   0, hx:  0, hy:  0, mo: 1.00, sw: 0.00 }
  ];

    t = ((t % PERIOD) + PERIOD) % PERIOD;
    var i = 0;

    var a = K[i], b = K[i + 1];
    var u = (t - a.t) / (b.t - a.t);
    u = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, u));
    var e = 0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos(Math.PI * u);

    el("face").setAttribute("transform", "rotate(" + n(-4 + p.fr) + " 117 50)");

    el("mouth").setAttribute("transform",
      "translate(117 56) scale(" + n(p.mo) + ") translate(-117 -56)");

    el("arm-left").setAttribute("transform", "rotate(" + n(8 * p.sw) + " 88 88)");
    el("arm-right").setAttribute("transform", "rotate(" + n(-6 * p.sw) + " 146 90)");
    el("leg-left").setAttribute("transform", "translate(" + n(-4 * p.sw) + " 0)");
    el("leg-right").setAttribute("transform", "translate(" + n(4 * p.sw) + " 0)");

    var sh = el("floor-shadow");
    sh.setAttribute("rx", n(54 + 10 * p.sq));
    sh.setAttribute("opacity", n(0.16 + 0.05 * p.sq));
  }

  window.nwb = { render: render };
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () { render(0); });
})();
